fusions.name: Drowning Roll
fusions.desc: A clamping roll that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Mud-Bank Lunge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 5 tiles to the target. The weapon strike deals 14 damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Eyes at the Waterline
fusions.desc: Veils you for 9 seconds and restores 10 health. Enemies notice you 70% later, you move 6% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Longer the Wait
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 40% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
